caption: A reverse split is a discovery event, not a thesis. book.note: Persisted run statistics from the local book; per-trade ledgers and equity curves are local artifacts and are not in the feed.
honest_limits: Historical locates are not in this database. The strict book is empty until timestamped pre-order availability and fee are imported.
Assumed fees are flat annual rates, not the fee the street quoted that day.
A phrase hit in an 8-K is not an announcement until the filing text is parsed (date_quality=filing_text); acceptance_time rows are search hits with a clock.
The original $50k completed-split comparator lost about $14,286 on 124 trades; selecting completed splits at announcement uses future outcomes.

The 2026-10-11 filing and corporate-action audit superseded the preliminary four-trade rerun gains (+$131 / +$1,123): ASTI was a historical split reference and PALI and IBO fell below the $1 printed-price floor once missing split factors were restored. The corrected 96-case rerun leaves one primary candidate (EDBL, a shareholder-authorization event) losing about $150 over five sessions and $582 over ten; 0 of 12 ten-session brackets are positive.
The persisted fundamental_60 book scenario (four trades) predates that audit, which removed three of its four leads; read its P&L as an input-error exhibit, not a result.
Current SEC exchange maps and Yahoo history are not a contemporaneous security master; delisted names and failed exit paths are censored, not zero returns.
FINRA short interest is positioning context, not shares that can be sold; the synthetic rows carry average volume only.
Prices, EDGAR phrase hits, control samples and per-trade ledgers are local build artifacts; this feed carries counts, dates and persisted run statistics only.
The decision journal records reviews and passes, not fills: no Sharpe, time-weighted return or closed-trade result exists until paper fills and daily equity are collected.

process.hypothesis: A newly announced reverse split can expose financing or operating impairment. Short only when filed deterioration, an equity valuation gap and a near-term catalyst align, and borrow and joint squeeze risk are affordable.

gates.label: Point-in-time fundamentals
gates.requires: Raw filing-availability-filtered SSI score of at least 60, three numeric signals, an operating-company profile and a latest period no more than 200 days old

gates.label: Fresh verified announcement
gates.requires: Substantive parsed announcement no more than seven calendar days old, before any known effective split; accession, ratio, identity and schedule reconciled by the reviewer

gates.label: Six evidence lenses
gates.requires: All six lenses reviewed with dated primary evidence, a locator, the mechanism, contrary evidence and a falsifier; two impairment lenses supported including cash/financing or operating impairment; valuation and catalyst supported; no contradicted lens

gates.label: Net payoff and carry
gates.requires: At least 30% gross downside to a reachable common-equity target, at least 20% after round-trip costs and seven-day carry, carry no more than 10% of notional

gates.label: Catalyst within hold window
gates.requires: A dated catalyst within seven calendar days and before a known split; exit after five sessions

gates.label: Fresh quote and locate
gates.requires: Executable quote within 15 minutes, approved locate within four hours with fee, size and reference, and an SSR execution check

gates.label: Shared-account survival
gates.requires: Notional of at least $100; all-account stressed margin and existing sleeve loss reconciled; three-name and joint squeeze limits

gates.label: Prospective decision
gates.requires: Evidence date equals the current Eastern date; historical reviews are tagged retrospective and excluded from forward validation

policy.entry: Review a substantive announcement within seven calendar days. Enter only after all gates pass and a fresh locate and executable quote are recorded. Paper entry is a plan; it is not an order or a simulated fill. Expired announcements require a new independently sourced event.
policy.exit: Cover after five sessions including entry, before a known split effective date, or when the catalyst resolves, the falsifier occurs or borrow is recalled. A 50% adverse price move triggers a cover instruction at the next executable opportunity; gaps and halts can exceed the loss budget. Never average into a losing short.
policy.selection: Raw as-of score ≥60, at least three numeric signals, latest period ≤200 days old. Review all six lenses; at least two of the first four must be supported, including cash/financing or operating impairment. Valuation and catalyst/path must both be supported. Contradicted lenses block entry.
policy.sizing: Whole shares limited by a 0.5% equity name loss budget under a +200% price shock, stressed carry and costs; 2% joint sleeve loss, three names, 2.5% notional, 0.1% prior 20-session ADV, locate size and stressed margin with a 20% equity buffer. These are chosen research limits, not guaranteed maximum losses.
policy.payoff: Require ≥30% gross valuation downside and ≥20% after entered round-trip costs and seven-day carry, with carry ≤10% of notional. Stress carry at triple the quoted fee and collateral at triple the entry price. Target value must be plausibly attainable within the five-session catalyst window.

validation: Freeze this version before collecting future outcomes; log every lead, pass and review, including missing data and unavailable borrow.
Use actual paper fill observations and daily marked equity after all costs; a ready decision is not performance. Preserve deposits/withdrawals separately to calculate time-weighted returns.
Compare split-only, fundamentals-only and combined portfolios using the same eligible point-in-time universe and capital rules. Current historical examples remain exploratory.

Report net TWR, drawdown, expected shortfall, worst issuer, carry drag, fill/locate rejection rate, uncertainty clustered by issuer and calendar, and incremental whole-portfolio drawdown and risk. No Sharpe is available until a valid daily equity series exists.
At 30 closed paper trades across ≥20 issuers and ≥6 months, review evidence rather than automatically approve deployment. Keep a later untouched cohort and disclose every version change.

decisions_summary.note: Append-only, hash-chained reviews and passes. A paper_ready row is a plan, not an order or a fill.
